blocks.text: Sulfur is used as a cross-linker for rubber molecular chains; this is vulcanisation, and it improves the strength of rubber (Figure 12.10: S-S cross-links between polymer chains).

blocks.alt: Two long, tangled orange polymer chains. At four places a pair of S atoms bridges two parts of the chains: each S is joined to a chain by a short line and the two S atoms are joined to each other. One S-S pair, near the top, is ringed.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.10: S-S cross-linkages between polymer chains (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 12.10).
